A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BuildArena study and contain readable main text and appendices A–G. Text comparison and visual inspection support reliable matching of the methods, equations, tables, figures and appendix material.

before.justification: v1 reports original Besiege simulation experiments evaluating eight LLMs across three construction tasks and three difficulty levels. Tables 2 and 3 report performance and cost, supplemented by failure analyses and construction examples.

after.justification: v4 retains these original simulation results, including the performance and cost tables, failure analyses and appendix construction examples.

M1.justification: The spatial computation library, Planner–Drafter–Reviewer–Builder–Guidance workflow, Transport controller and construction procedures are unchanged. Appendices E and G retain the same operations and prompts; graphical refinements do not introduce a different method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Transport, Support and Lift at the same three difficulty levels. The vehicle, cargo, bridge and rocket scenarios and their task requirements remain identical, including Appendix F.

E2.justification: Tables 2 and 3 retain the same eight evaluated models: GPT-4o, Claude-4, Grok-4, Gemini-2.0, DeepSeek-3.1, Qwen-3, Kimi-K2 and Seed-1.6. No comparator is added, removed or replaced.

E3.justification: The model snapshots, six-module selection, Besiege v1.75 configuration, 25 Hz trajectory recording and task-specific evaluation procedures remain unchanged. Sections 2.4 and Appendices D, F and G retain the same metrics and controls.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same failure-reason analysis, capability profiles and cost–performance analysis in Figures 6–8. Construction case studies in Figures 5, 9 and 10 are retained without additional ablations or robustness analyses.

E5.justification: Both report 64 samples per task–LLM pair and averages over those samples. Figure 8 retains the same mean-and-standard-deviation reporting; no repeated-run, seed or statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Performance and cost entries in Tables 2 and 3, plotted findings and qualitative construction results are unchanged. For example, Grok-4 retains 31.2% success and a maximum-height indicator of 890.6 for Lift Lv.2 in Table 2.

T1.justification: Appendix E retains the same mathematical definitions of construction states, module attributes, pose mappings, action trajectories and control sequences. No assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same novelty claim and four contributions: the customizable benchmark, task-design strategy, spatial computation library and baseline agentic workflow. Their scientific scope is unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of spatial and compositional weaknesses, engineering-like constructions and inference cost remain unchanged. Section 4 retains the limitations concerning the missing evaluation-driven refinement loop and restricted module diversity.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, simulator settings, model identifiers, module specifications, tool examples and prompts are retained. The existing project link moves from the abstract to the author area but points to the same destination; code-access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2.1 replaces Zhao et al. (2023), concerning electromechanical failure propagation, with Geng et al. (2025), concerning instruction-hierarchy failures, as the robustness citation. Other edits largely update bibliographic records for existing titles. The broader research positioning and Appendix A discussion remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 removes Yixian Jiang from the author list, specifies the laboratory affiliation, removes the Preprint header text and relocates the project-page sentence. Citation metadata and corresponding in-text references are edited, while the scientific prose and section organization remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: v4 adds a first-page laboratory logo, centers the author block and changes header spacing and vertical page placement. Figures 2 and 4 have cleaner rendering of lettering and lines while retaining their content. Tables and other scientific figures retain their structure and content.

improvement.justification: v4 provides limited visual polish and bibliographic updates, but the diagrams communicate the same workflow and the scientific explanation, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged. The localized citation substitution and front-matter edits do not materially alter the paper's overall clarity or evidential support.
